title: Veeam Backup & Replication or Acronis Cyber Protect: Enterprise Backup vs All-in-One Protection
excerpt: Two popular backup platforms with different goals. Veeam focuses on deep backup and recovery for virtualised infrastructure; Acronis combines backup with anti-malware and endpoint management in one agent.
verdict: Veeam is the stronger option for larger organisations with complex virtual environments that need enterprise-grade backup, replication and recovery testing. Acronis suits small businesses that want backup and anti-malware in one simpler tool and one console.
